decisions.reason: The one-video YouTube source constraint is an independent same-message decision already represented under this Requirement; the editing-style change does not alter it.
Moment completeness and teaching value are independent same-message requirements, not consequences of the clean and simple editing-style modification.
Prohibiting crazy effects and transitions does not necessarily alter the existing requirement to use color in captions or letters.
The clean, professional, and simple editing-style decision does not replace or modify the existing strong-moment selection standard.
The source editing-style modification does not change the existing 30-to-90-second duration requirement.
The source repeats the existing future Lead Clipper training pathway, team-management role, and compensation without necessarily changing the candidate state.
The current three-clip qualification process and requirement to pass the quality standard remain unchanged; the editing-style details belong to the source Requirement.
The source repeats the existing quota of 125 approved clips per month and does not modify the quota Requirement.
The request to send three clips does not necessarily change the existing project-chat submission channel or sample-review workflow.
